# GitHub give a document a different meaning, one per line: the example ID,
# the rule, a colon, and the section of ../markfmt/grammar.txt whose case gives
# markfmt's expected HTML (design 2.1, 11.4). The test fails when an entry no
# longer differs, when its case is missing or has another input, and when an
# entry is also in failing.txt.
